H3_gate_improves_quality_under_attack.statement: held-out accuracy with the certified gate > without it, on a test set the gate never saw
H3_gate_improves_quality_under_attack.caveat: A configuration where the gated model is byte-identical to the frozen pretrained checkpoint is NOT evidence that the gate works: it means the gate rejected every round, so the comparison only shows that federated training was net-harmful in that cell. This is audit finding F5 and it must be read together with the C1 verdict.
